title: UneceTransportMeans
description: Reference to a device or method used to convey people, goods, or other objects from place to place.

driverAccompaniedIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this referenced means of transport is accompanied by a driver.

identifier.description: An identifier of this referenced transport means, such as the International Maritime Organization number for a vessel.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, of this referenced transport means, such as the vessel name.

transportMeansType.description: The type, expressed as text, of this referenced transport means.

transportMeansTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of referenced transport means [Reference UNECE Recommendation 28].
